drug_class: Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF) Inhibitor - Monoclonal Antibody

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: TNF-alpha stimulation may counteract adalimumab's immunosuppressive effects and reduce therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; consider alternative immune support with healthcare provider approval

avoid_supplements.name: Live Probiotics (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May cause infection risk in immunocompromised patients receiving TNF inhibitors; contraindicated during active immunosuppression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose live bacterial supplements; consult pharmacist/physician before use

avoid_supplements.name: Astragalus
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune-stimulating properties may reduce adalimumab efficacy and increase infection/autoimmune complications
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue; discuss alternative herbal supplements with provider

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Moderate immune modulation; deficiency common in TNF inhibitor users and may require monitoring
caution_supplements.action: Monitor levels; supplementation may be beneficial if deficient (consult provider for dosing)

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Anti-inflammatory properties generally synergistic with adalimumab but may potentiate bleeding at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use at standard doses; monitor for unusual bleeding or bruising

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild anti-inflammatory; may have additive effects with adalimumab at moderate doses
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously at culinary amounts; avoid therapeutic doses without provider approval

avoid_foods.name: Unpasteurized/Raw Animal Products
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increased infection risk from pathogens (Listeria, Salmonella, E. coli) in severely immunocompromised patients on TNF inhibitors
avoid_foods.action: Strictly avoid raw/undercooked meat, seafood, eggs, and unpasteurized dairy; ensure all foods are properly cooked/pasteurized

caution_foods.name: High-Sugar Foods/Processed Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May promote chronic inflammation and reduce adalimumab efficacy; increase infection risk
caution_foods.action: Limit intake; emphasize whole foods, lean proteins, and anti-inflammatory diet

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (Moderate-High Intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk; adalimumab associated with rare liver injury; alcohol increases risk
caution_foods.action: Limit to ≤1 drink/day for women, ≤2 for men; monitor liver function tests

monitoring_notes: Adalimumab significantly increases infection risk and requires avoidance of live vaccines and immunostimulating supplements. Monitor liver function tests, CBC, and signs of infection; educate patients on food safety and avoidance of live/raw foods, particularly in immunocompromised states.
